title: Bigger Game

texts.details:
Ya done wit' scorpids an' tigers, mon? Den ya ready for de Barrens. West over de river, past Far Watch, an' de land opens so wide ya can't see de end of it.

Dey say it was all forest once, tended by de night elves, till de world broke an' de sun burned it flat. De tauren hunted it after dat, wit' de centaur always at deir backs. Now de Kolkar ride de north of it an' de Razormane quilboar hold de thorns. De Horde got outposts, an' de biggest be de Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn runs de Crossroads. Tell her Vel'rin sends someone who can hunt.
texts.objectives: Cross into the Barrens and present yourself to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
texts.completion:
Vel'rin says so? He does not say it often.

The land, the water, and the sky are all as one, $N, and here you can see all three at once. Do not let that fool you into thinking the Barrens is empty. The centaur and the quilboar were here before us, and neither has agreed that we may stay.

Rest. Then we will see what you can hunt.

idea: On the road from Durotar to the Barrens: once a forest tended by the night elves, scorched after the Sundering; tauren and centaur; Kolkar and Razormane; the Crossroads as the largest Horde outpost.
